actions.custom_api_call.description: Make a custom API call to a specific endpoint
actions.custom_api_call.props.failsafe.d: On a failed request, output the error instead of failing the step.
actions.custom_api_call.props.followRedi: Follow 3xx redirects instead of returning them as the response.
actions.custom_api_call.props.headers.de: Authorization headers are injected automatically from your connection.
actions.custom_api_call.props.response_i: Enable for files like PDFs, images, etc.
actions.custom_api_call.props.timeout.de: Seconds to wait for a response. Empty: up to the flow limit (10 min).
actions.get_app_details.description: Retrieve detailed information about a specific PromptMate app
actions.get_app_details.props.appId.desc: Select the app to get details for
actions.get_job_status.description: Retrieve the status and results of a PromptMate app job
actions.get_job_status.props.appId.descr: Select the app for which to get job status
actions.get_job_status.props.jobId.descr: The ID of the job to check
actions.get_job_status.props.onlyDefault: Return only the default result fields
actions.get_last_results.description: Retrieve the last result rows of a PromptMate app for examples or testing
actions.get_last_results.props.appId.des: Select the app to get last results for
actions.get_last_results.props.limit.des: Maximum number of result rows to return
actions.get_last_results.props.onlyDefau: Return only the default result fields
actions.get_user_info.description: Retrieve user information associated with the API key
actions.list_apps.description: Retrieve a list of available apps
actions.list_projects.description: Retrieve a list of available PromptMate projects
actions.run_app.description: Runs a PromptMate app with the specified data
actions.run_app.props.appId.description: Select the PromptMate app to run
actions.run_app.props.callBackUrl.descri: URL to which the result of the job will be sent (optional)
actions.run_app.props.config.description: Configuration settings for the job (language, country, etc.)
actions.run_app.props.data.description: Array of data objects to process. Each object must contain the required data fields for the selected app.
actions.run_app.props.noMailOnFinish.des: Send an email to the user when the job has finished
actions.use_template.description: Create an app from a specific PromptMate template
actions.use_template.props.templateId.de: The ID of the template to use
triggers.new_app_result.description: Triggers when there is a new app result from PromptMate
triggers.new_app_result.props.restricted: Only trigger for results from these specific apps. Leave empty to trigger for all apps.
triggers.new_app_result.props.webhookRef: Optional reference for this webhook (used for identification)
triggers.new_app_result.props.webhookTyp: Choose when to trigger the webhook
